sync.title: Sync
sync.subtitle: Work done offline is saved on this device and sent automatically when the internet is back.
sync.went_offline: You're offline. Keep working: everything is saved here and sent when the internet returns.
sync.partial_one: {{count}} change sent; others are still pending.
sync.partial_other: {{count}} changes sent; others are still pending.
sync.empty_hint: Nothing is waiting to be sent.
sync.login_needed: Your session expired. Sign in again with the same user: pending work is kept and will be sent automatically.
sync.not_durable: This browser can't store data on the device. Keep the app open until everything is sent.
sync.can_do: Offline you can use the whole app: view your screens, register lots, count and test, create orders and quick sales, edit customers, sellers, suppliers and assets, place units and change statuses, costs and prices. Only settings, reports, audit and server PDFs/labels need internet.
sync.discard_msg: What you did offline will not be sent to the server.
sync.discard_more_one: {{count}} action that depends on it will also be discarded.
sync.discard_more_other: {{count}} actions that depend on it will also be discarded.
sync.pending_hint: Saved on this device; it will be sent when the internet returns.
sync.saved_offline: Saved offline. It will be sent when the internet returns.
sync.logout_pending: You have unsent changes. They stay on this device and will be sent when you sign in again with this user.
sync.labels_later: Labels are printed once you're back online.
sync.delete_lot_hint: Only lots with no data yet (no units and no counts) can be deleted.
